narrative: The almanac lies open at the end of December in the last of the window light. His inked forefinger rests under St Stephen's day. The cut list is still in the other hand. The margin of this Sunday has the feast and the church, and no other mark. The phrase is written once. He does not add a play, an hour, or a sum. Frost is still on the pane above the desk.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted, and wrote the line once.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in Twenty-six days
